dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃ〜ん、席空いてるよ〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniicha~n, there are empty seats here!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniicha~n, there are empty seats here!"

dialogues.jp:
聞き覚えのある声に、しかし、振り返ったのは
俺だけではなかった。
dialogues.en:
I turn around at the familiar voice, but I'm not the only
one who does.
dialogues.text:
I turn around at the familiar voice, but I'm not the only
one who does.

dialogues.jp:
周囲の男子学生のほとんどが、なにか凄絶なモ
ノでも見るように首を曲げている。
dialogues.en:
Most of the male students there look like they're seeing
something horrific.
dialogues.text:
Most of the male students there look like they're seeing
something horrific.

dialogues.jp: 怖いよお前ら……。
dialogues.en: Guys, it's not pleasant...
dialogues.text: Guys, it's not pleasant...

dialogues.jp: 「そしてお前も落ち着け」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you. Settle down."
dialogues.text: "Hey, you. Settle down."

dialogues.jp:
カレーの載ったトレイをおいて、さくらの前の
席の椅子をひく。
dialogues.en:
I put down my tray of curried rice and pull up the chair in
front of Sakura.
dialogues.text:
I put down my tray of curried rice and pull up the chair in
front of Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにょ。ご飯を元気に食べずになにをする
　ぞ！」
dialogues.en: "Hm. What's wrong with eating my lunch energetically?"
dialogues.text: "Hm. What's wrong with eating my lunch energetically?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「元気と騒々しいとは別物だ」
dialogues.en: "There's a difference between being energetic and noisy."
dialogues.text: "There's a difference between being energetic and noisy."

dialogues.jp: ため息をついて水を一口含む。
dialogues.en: I take a sip of water with a sigh.
dialogues.text: I take a sip of water with a sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あれ、兄さ〜ん！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, niisan!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, niisan!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……だから叫ぶな音夢」
dialogues.en: "Geez, don't yell, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Geez, don't yell, Nemu."

dialogues.jp:
振り返ると、やはりトレイを手に困ったように
音夢が辺りを見渡している。
dialogues.en:
I look behind me to see Nemu, holding a tray and looking
around with a troubled expression.
dialogues.text:
I look behind me to see Nemu, holding a tray and looking
around with a troubled expression.

dialogues.jp:
こんなところで、血が繋がっていないようにし
か見えない妹ふたりに声を上げられることは、
俺の死に直結する。
dialogues.en:
I feel like I'm about to die when my two sisters call my
name loudly in public. Their personality is completely
different to mine, as if they were complete strangers.
dialogues.text:
I feel like I'm about to die when my two sisters call my
name loudly in public. Their personality is completely
different to mine, as if they were complete strangers.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どこですかぁ？」
dialogues.en: "Where are you?"
dialogues.text: "Where are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、もう……こっちだ音夢！」
dialogues.en: "Oh, God... Over here, Nemu!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, God... Over here, Nemu!"

dialogues.jp:
面倒なので中途半端にしか重力に逆らえなかっ
た手を振る。
dialogues.en:
I wave my hand, but half-heartedly, because I'm too tired
and gravity's too strong.
dialogues.text:
I wave my hand, but half-heartedly, because I'm too tired
and gravity's too strong.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、もう、どこ行ってるの？　あやうく私、
　迷子になるところだったよ」
dialogues.en: "C'mon, where have you been? I almost got lost."
dialogues.text: "C'mon, where have you been? I almost got lost."

dialogues.jp:
さくらにチョコンと笑いかけて、音夢が俺の隣
に座る。
dialogues.en: Giving a quick smile to Sakura, Nemu sits down next to me.
dialogues.text: Giving a quick smile to Sakura, Nemu sits down next to me.

dialogues.jp: 「そうしたら放送で呼んでやるわ」
dialogues.en: "Next time, I'll send you a broadcast."
dialogues.text: "Next time, I'll send you a broadcast."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「わぁ、やめてよ遊園地みたいなことするの！」
dialogues.en:
"You'd better not. That'd be just like an announcement at an
amusement park."
dialogues.text:
"You'd better not. That'd be just like an announcement at an
amusement park."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ、音夢ちゃん遊園地で迷子になったこ
　とあるある？」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, have you ever been lost at an amusement park before,
Nemu?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, have you ever been lost at an amusement park before,
Nemu?"

dialogues.jp:
ちなみに各人のメニューは、俺カレー、さくら
はうどん、音夢がランチセットとなっておりま
す。
dialogues.en:
For your information, I ordered curried rice, Sakura ordered
udon noodles and Nemu ordered a set lunch menu.
dialogues.text:
For your information, I ordered curried rice, Sakura ordered
udon noodles and Nemu ordered a set lunch menu.

dialogues.jp:
「うぅ……しかし、お前らの兄さんとかお兄ちゃ
　ん、ってどうにかならないか？」
dialogues.en:
"Umm... Can you call me something other than 'oniichan' or
'niisan'?"
dialogues.text:
"Umm... Can you call me something other than 'oniichan' or
'niisan'?"

dialogues.jp: カレーをすくいながらため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I sigh as I scoop curried rice.
dialogues.text: I sigh as I scoop curried rice.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんで？」
dialogues.en: "Why?"
dialogues.text: "Why?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……俺の敵がどんどん増えていくからだ」
dialogues.en: "Because calling me those makes me more enemies."
dialogues.text: "Because calling me those makes me more enemies."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私が兄さんのこと名前で呼び出したら、逆に
　皆に誤解されると思うけど……」
dialogues.en:
"If I start to call you by your first name, I think they'll
get the wrong idea about us."
dialogues.text:
"If I start to call you by your first name, I think they'll
get the wrong idea about us."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「問題はボクかな？　でも、なんて呼ぶの？」
dialogues.en: "Am I the problem? But what else can I call you, then?"
dialogues.text: "Am I the problem? But what else can I call you, then?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうだな。あくまで萌えランクを下げないこ
　とを前提にしよう」
dialogues.en: "Well, just try not to make me sound unimportant."
dialogues.text: "Well, just try not to make me sound unimportant."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ご隠居とか旦那様とか？」
dialogues.en: "'My old man'? 'My master'?"
dialogues.text: "'My old man'? 'My master'?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「誰の萌えポイントだそれは……」
dialogues.en: "Who'll get the point for that?"
dialogues.text: "Who'll get the point for that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まったく……なんの話してるのよ」
dialogues.en: "What the heck are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What the heck are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が箸をくわえながらため息を吐く。
dialogues.en: Nemu gives a sigh and puts her chopsticks in her mouth.
dialogues.text: Nemu gives a sigh and puts her chopsticks in her mouth.

dialogues.jp:
「ご主人様とかさくらが言い出したら、なかな
　か厳しい勝負になるな音夢」
dialogues.en:
"If Sakura starts calling me 'my master', it's gonna be a
very tough game for you, huh, Nemu?"
dialogues.text:
"If Sakura starts calling me 'my master', it's gonna be a
very tough game for you, huh, Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あのねぇ……」
dialogues.en: "You know what?"
dialogues.text: "You know what?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ご主人様ぁん♪」
dialogues.en: "My master!"
dialogues.text: "My master!"

dialogues.jp:
いつの間にか、机の下でもくぐってきたのか、
さくらが俺の腰に抱きついていた。
dialogues.en:
I have no idea if Sakura sneaked across under the table or
not, but she had already flung her arms around my waist
before I knew it.
dialogues.text:
I have no idea if Sakura sneaked across under the table or
not, but she had already flung her arms around my waist
before I knew it.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ご奉仕させてくださいご主人様〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Let me work for you, my master!"
dialogues.text: "Let me work for you, my master!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……嬉しそうね兄さん」
dialogues.en: "You look happy, niisan."
dialogues.text: "You look happy, niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「さくら……俺の敵が増えるからやめようソレ」
dialogues.en: "Sakura, I don't want any more enemies, so let's stop it."
dialogues.text: "Sakura, I don't want any more enemies, so let's stop it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ。残念無念だね」
dialogues.en: "Mmm... What a shame!"
dialogues.text: "Mmm... What a shame!"

dialogues.jp: そうだな。
dialogues.en: True enough.
dialogues.text: True enough.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そういえばさ、ちょっとボク思い出した
　んだよ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I just remembered something."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I just remembered something."

dialogues.jp:
自分の席に戻らず、そのまま立ち上がってさく
らが微笑む。
dialogues.en:
Sakura smiles, standing where she is without going back to
her chair.
dialogues.text:
Sakura smiles, standing where she is without going back to
her chair.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なにを？」
dialogues.en: "What did you remember?"
dialogues.text: "What did you remember?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん。昔３人で遊んだなって」
dialogues.en:
"Um... I remember when the three of us used to play
together."
dialogues.text:
"Um... I remember when the three of us used to play
together."

dialogues.jp: どこか懐かしそうに目を細める。
dialogues.en: She closes her eyes in nostalgia.
dialogues.text: She closes her eyes in nostalgia.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんが先生で、注射だよってお医者さ
　んごっこ――」
dialogues.en: "You pretended to be a doctor and gave me an injection..."
dialogues.text: "You pretended to be a doctor and gave me an injection..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うらぁ！」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Jesus!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, Jesus!"

dialogues.jp: さくらを抱え上げて走り出す。
dialogues.en: I pick Sakura up and begin to run.
dialogues.text: I pick Sakura up and begin to run.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?!"
dialogues.text: "What?!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「音夢、そのカレーとうどんをやる！　カレー
　うどんにしてでも食え！」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, Nemu, you can have my curried rice and her udon
noodles! Why don't you eat them together as udon noodles
with curry?!"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, Nemu, you can have my curried rice and her udon
noodles! Why don't you eat them together as udon noodles
with curry?!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「無茶だよぉ」
dialogues.en: "I don't think so."
dialogues.text: "I don't think so."

dialogues.jp:
情けない声を背後に聞きながら、とりあえずど
こか安全な場所を目指す。
dialogues.en:
Hearing her merciless voice behind me, I run off to a safe
place for now.
dialogues.text:
Hearing her merciless voice behind me, I run off to a safe
place for now.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「もぅ、大胆なんだから……」
dialogues.en: "C'mon, how dare you do this?"
dialogues.text: "C'mon, how dare you do this?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お前も黙ってろ〜〜〜っ！」
dialogues.en: "You, be quiet!"
dialogues.text: "You, be quiet!"

dialogues.jp:
こんなに目立ちたくはないのに、食堂中の不思
議な視線を受けて走る。
dialogues.en:
I have to run through the dining hall, attracting everyone's
attention. It's not exactly the quiet lunch I'd hoped for.
dialogues.text:
I have to run through the dining hall, attracting everyone's
attention. It's not exactly the quiet lunch I'd hoped for.

dialogues.jp: かったるい。
dialogues.en: What a pain in the neck.
dialogues.text: What a pain in the neck.

dialogues.jp: そして、また敵が増えていくのだった。
dialogues.en: And I will have more enemies.
dialogues.text: And I will have more enemies.

dialogues.jp: ◆お医者さんごっこ……◆
dialogues.en: ◆Play doctor...◆
dialogues.text: ◆Play doctor...◆

dialogues.jp:
さくらと音夢と一緒に食堂で相席することにな
り、いつの間にか昔の思い出話に花が咲くこと
に。
dialogues.en:
I happened to sit with Sakura and Nemu in the dining hall,
and we enjoyed talking about our good old days.
dialogues.text:
I happened to sit with Sakura and Nemu in the dining hall,
and we enjoyed talking about our good old days.

dialogues.jp:
そこで、迂闊にもさくらがお医者さんごっこの
話題なんて持ち出すので、俺は泣く泣く食堂か
ら逃げ去ることになってしまった……。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, Sakura started to talk about how we played doctor,
so I had no choice but to run away from the dining hall...
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, Sakura started to talk about how we played doctor,
so I had no choice but to run away from the dining hall...
